secciones.h2: Meta Ads or Google Ads: which one fits you
p: Facebook and Instagram advertising in Ecuador works very well to create demand: you reach people who are not searching for you yet. Google Ads in Ecuador captures existing demand: people who already search for what you sell. Many businesses start with one platform and add the other when the cost per lead allows it. In the free diagnostic I recommend which to use first based on your offer and budget.
For businesses that already have something to sell and need more qualified inquiries.

Businesses that already run ads but do not know whether their spend pays off.

p: These prices are the monthly management, not including ad spend: you pay the ad spend directly to the platform, from your own account.

secciones.h2: How much to invest in ad spend
p: The minimum ad spend I recommend is {pautaDia} a day, which is {pautaMes} a month. With less budget it is hard for the platform to learn and for you to get useful data to decide. Later, if the metrics justify it, it can be scaled.

An honest note: platforms change their rules and their algorithm, and they can reject ads or suspend accounts. That is why I do not guarantee figures for leads, sales or return; what I do guarantee is transparency in how we measure and optimize.

We start with a free diagnostic of 30 to 45 minutes. Then I send you a fixed-price proposal. During execution you get weekly updates, and from the second month we move into continuous follow-up and optimization, with weekly reports on campaigns.

I need to know what you sell, to whom and how much a customer is worth to you. I also need access to your ad account (or I help you create it), your page and your website, and a way to receive inquiries, whether WhatsApp, a form or calls. If your site is not ready to receive traffic, I tell you before you spend on ads.

Ad spend is not included: you pay Meta or Google directly. Producing new pieces, such as carousels or videos, is not included either; those are quoted in the social content service. If your site needs improving to convert better, that is quoted as web design.

You work directly with me, with reports in plain language and decisions based on real data. The ad account is always yours, the price is fixed and results are measured by cost per lead and by the inquiries that actually reach you, not by numbers that decorate a report.
